finish.summary: Built 1-cell closed enclosure: full base with top cover and all side caps, fitted with Port louvre vent for breathing. House rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied, meshClash clear. No props placed as enclosure is closed; printed plastic is not certified for waterproofing, heat or electrical safety - those aspects are unmet beyond shape.
